entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: There's a light exhibit that[n]can only be seen at night.[n]Isn't that interesting?

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I wanted to teach you things like[n]that. This is an extracurricular [n]lesson to enhance your education.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: ...Eheh... Or something.[n]It's more like a thanks for[n]helping me make up my mind.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I'm going to start acting [n]like an honest teacher again.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Ooh, I feel like I never hear[n]you talk like that.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: It would be really easy to[n]teach you if you were always[n]this compliant.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Hey... Don't underestimate me.[n]I can whip out a lecture[n]on paintings any day.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Hrgh... You just had to[n]go there, didn't you...?

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: W-Well, that's fine! Just be[n]quiet and follow me! I'm going[n]to rehabilitate you!

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: *giggle* I realized that[n]I love being a teacher.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: It's really rewarding, you know?[n]Especially the moments when you[n]realize how a student's grown...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Okay, let's resume our lesson![n]If there's anything you don't [n]understand, please ask me!

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: ...Wait, no! I take that back![n]Just ask me simple questions,[n]okay? Please?

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: This was fun, huh?[n]Okay, let's go home.
